status: Microsoft labels the Surface Laptop Ultra as a pre-release product; features may change and vary by country or region.
facts: Microsoft describes the laptop as built for local AI workloads and 3D graphics.
Microsoft says users can run local agents and automate routine tasks locally, reserving the cloud for larger AI workloads.
The display is a 15-inch touchscreen. Microsoft lists zooming, marking up, scrolling, signing, and navigating directly on the display.
The touchscreen is optimized for touch interaction only. Pen input and compatibility with Surface Pen, Surface Slim Pen, or similar accessories are not supported.
Microsoft describes the touchpad as its largest precision haptic touchpad.
The built-in magnetic USB-C charging port combines magnetic convenience with standard USB-C connectivity.
The listed ports are three USB-C ports, USB-A, HDMI, an SD card reader, and a headphone jack. Only the USB-C port count is specified here.
Microsoft mentions internal wayfinding, published repair guides, replacement parts, and upgradeable storage. Replacement components and service options vary by market and over time.
